fields.description: Issue includes local political and civic commentary and reporting, including coverage of allegations of graft and corruption involving city offices and discussion of Stanley Massey’s legal situation; an update on Miami’s telephone rate-reduction fight and expected action by the State Railroad Commission; and commentary on labor organizing among Southern Bell Telephone Company employees. The issue also features Miami Life’s “most attractive working girl” contest (Burdines winner Miss Lillian Bishop) and a ballot for the Florida Power & Light Company contest, along with society/round-the-town items, letters to the editor, and sports/racing content (Jockey Jimmy reports and results).
